messages:
Maria Chen: Heads up — we're pausing the webinar launch emails until we confirm incident recovery. Need marketing + support alignment on customer-facing wording and lead routing. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Jamal Ortiz: Agreed. Can we decide statuspage copy first? Ops wants something brief that doesn't overpromise.

Lucy Patel: Draft options below (keeping <140 chars):

Option A (safe):
```
Our service is experiencing elevated error rates for some model inference requests. Engineers are investigating; no data loss expected. We'll post updates here as we learn more.
```

Option B (more urgent):
```
Some requests may fail or be delayed. We're actively investigating and have mitigation steps in flight. If you rely on low-latency endpoints for production, contact support for a status update.
```

Jamal Ortiz: I like A for the public statuspage, B for targeted emails to impacted customers.

OpsBot: incident-2026-03-21-1918202468 created by SRE Bot — severity: partial-degradation — assigned: eng-oncall. https://ops.example.com/incidents/1918202468

Elena Park: For registrants: we should send a short note acknowledging the issue and saying webinar will proceed unless the live demo requires inference. Suggest this copy:

```
Hi — quick update: we're experiencing an internal service issue. We're monitoring closely; the webinar is still planned. If anything changes (impacting the demo), we'll notify registrants at least 30 minutes before start. Thanks for your patience.
```

Zach Kim: For inbound leads during the incident, propose routing rules:

```
if lead.tier == "enterprise":
  route: account-exec + customer-success
  cc: eng-oncall if mentions "production impact"
else:
  route: growth-sdr
```

Zach Kim: Also add an auto-reply for support@ and demo@ saying "We are investigating an incident; response times might be slower. For urgent production impact, include your org and SLA tier." Keeps expectations clear.

Maria Chen: Good. Quick decision needed: send registrant note now (short) or wait until we confirm no live-demo dependency? Thoughts?

Lucy Patel: I'd send the registrant note now — low-friction and builds trust. Mention possible change and promise a last-minute email if demo changes. Keep copy simple.

Jamal Ortiz: For statuspage publish timing: publish Option A now with a line linking to the incident page and our expected cadence (updates every 15–30m). Then email impacted enterprise customers with Option B + contact link.

Elena Park: I'll prepare the support template and owner list for enterprise outreach. Can we triage the customer list to flag orgs with active Dedicated/Private deployments? Those are SLA-critical.

Zach Kim: I'll push the routing rule to the automation pipeline. Quick check: do we want eng-oncall notified on every enterprise lead during the incident? Might be noisy.

Maria Chen: Only if the inbound message includes keywords: "production", "outage", "SLA", "latency". Otherwise route to AE/CS.

Lucy Patel: Drafting registrant email now and the statuspage snippet. I'll paste here in 10m.

Jamal Ortiz: I'll publish the statuspage and set the update cadence. Ops — can you confirm the incident link will auto-update with timeline entries?

OpsBot: Incident timeline auto-updates enabled. Next status push scheduled at +15m.

Elena Park: Triage checklist for enterprise outreach:
- list of impacted orgs
- contact owner + AE
- pre-approved escalation copy
- Slack channel for real-time sync

Elena Park: I'll own the checklist and post updates to #customer-success.

Maria Chen: Action items:
- Jamal: publish statuspage (Option A) & set cadence — by 1918202488
- Lucy: registrant email draft — by 1918202500
- Elena: enterprise triage sheet + outreach owners — by 1918202520
- Zach: push lead-routing rule + auto-reply — by 1918202520

Maria Chen: If we're stable at +30m we proceed with the webinar and follow up with a post-webinar summary about the incident and mitigations. If not, we send the postponement email with clear reschedule options.

Jamal Ortiz: ack — will post status and ping when done. :thumbsup:

Lucy Patel: ack — pasting draft in channel in a sec.

Zach Kim: ack — updating routing rules now.

Elena Park: ack — starting triage.

Maria Chen: Thanks all — prioritized and coordinated. I'll post a final note in 30m or earlier if things change. :white_check_mark:
